issues: CameraMotionBlur 20 次子帧叠加在 8bit 下累加出色偏：整片偏黄，连静止的 hold 帧都被染色，和其他镜头接不上
甩动段的拖影是一格一格的回波残影，不是连续的速度涂抹，糊帧里能数出重影
模糊量与速度无关（快门角固定），起止帧和峰值帧的糊程度不成比例
changes: 去掉 CameraMotionBlur，改用按瞬时速度计算的方向性高斯拖影（SpeedBlur，sd ≈ 0.085×速度、封顶 64px），只在甩动段生效
静止段不挂任何 filter，颜色与原始纹理逐像素一致（纸色 #f9f6f1 不再偏黄）
保留 8f / 2880px / bezier(0.6,0,0.4,1) 的甩动曲线与两端 hold；起止低速几乎不糊、中段峰值 ~780px/f 糊到不可辨，借糊帧换景
issuesEn: CameraMotionBlur's 20 sub-frame accumulation drifted color in 8-bit: the whole shot turned yellowish, even the static hold frames, so it no longer matched neighbouring shots
The smear during the whip was stepped echo ghosts rather than a continuous speed streak — you could count the copies
Blur amount ignored speed (fixed shutter angle), so start/end frames and the peak frame weren't blurred in proportion
changesEn: Replaced CameraMotionBlur with a directional Gaussian smear driven by instantaneous velocity (SpeedBlur, sd ≈ 0.085×speed, capped at 64px), active only during the whip
Static frames carry no filter at all, so colors match the source texture pixel for pixel (the #f9f6f1 paper tone no longer yellows)
Kept the 8f / 2880px / bezier(0.6,0,0.4,1) whip curve and both holds; low speed at the ends barely blurs, while the ~780px/f peak smears past recognition to hide the scene change
